description: FL701 service drawing compared with observed one-hot commands
counting_convention: Whole word legends count once, not once per letter or ink fragment.
Individual matrix cells, meter dots, bars, index symbols and red strokes count separately.
Slot 0 bit 14 accounts for 14 meter dots.
Slot 25 bit 9 accounts for two strokes of the adjacent digit 1.
Slot 24 bit 11 accounts for MONO and its separate index 2.
The left red glyph centre line is split by its two observed commands; the small drawing does not resolve its wiring.
methods: Reference matrices extracted at grayscale <160 from x212..1003, y73..118.
22 independent enclosed matrix outlines, each containing exactly 35 holes.
Reference and optical fields paired by their independent left-to-right order.
Every local matrix fit has a unique nearest reference cell below half the minimum cell spacing.
14 meter bar outlines independently counted; bottom dots visually reviewed.
Other reference symbols manually enumerated and visually compared with individual optical captures; not OCR.
No global pixel IoU: the service drawing is not a metric phosphor mask.
limitations: Reference-level functional coverage, not proof of every phosphor pixel or uniform brightness.
Letter outlines, negative-contrast pads and outlined matrix cells differ from camera emission cores.
Tiny red-glyph stroke boundaries are approximate in this low-resolution drawing.
No resolved response for 194 commands still does not establish that they are unused.
Electrical/current safety and absence of faint ghosting are not certified.
Tube outline, terminal pins and terminal numbers are non-emitting reference context, excluded.
Comparison is offline; no new output or simultaneous all-elements illumination was used.
evidence: display-command-map.json: per-command consensus emission runs and components
display-validation-375.json: revalidation of the original 560 commands
